meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: MUST USE when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, fetch, export, or reconstruct coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, Senpi/pi, OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Amp, Gemini/Kimi/Qwen CLIs, Codebuff, Roo/Kilo/Cline, Kodu, Cursor CLI, Aider, or unknown local agent logs. Covers transcripts, session IDs, rollout JSONL, state SQLite, Claude projects/pre-compact histories, OpenCode messages/parts, child/subagent linkage, cwd/model/time/token filters, archives, and cost clues. Expands fuzzy recall into parallel query lanes and first probes known stores so absent platforms are skipped cheaply. Triggers: coding agent sessions, Codex/Claude/OpenCode/Senpi/pi/OpenClaw/Droid/Amp/Kodu/Cursor/Aider sessions, transcript search, session history, session ID, read transcript, token usage, subagent sessions, what did I do yesterday, did we already do this.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索和回顾各类编码助手的对话记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常使用编码助手并需要快速查找之前的对话。
copy.tagline_en: Search and review coding agent session transcripts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use coding agents and need to quickly find past conversations.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索本地电脑上多个编程助手（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等）的历史对话记录，并读取其中的内容。
howto.when: 当你询问关于之前编程助手会话的问题，比如“我昨天做了什么”、“我们之前修过这个 bug 吗”，或者要求查找、列出、读取某个会话时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下昨天用 Codex 修复部署问题的会话。
列出最近一周所有 OpenCode 的会话。
say.note: Claude 会调用脚本列出 OpenCode 的会话列表。

say.text: 读取会话 ID 为 abc123 的完整记录。
say.note: Claude 会显示该会话的详细内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search local history sessions from multiple coding agents (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode) and read their contents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous coding-agent sessions, such as 'what did I do yesterday', 'did we fix this bug before', or request to find, list, or read a session.

say_en.text: Find the session where I fixed the deployment issue with Codex yesterday.
say_en.note: Claude will search Codex local records and return matching sessions.

say_en.text: List all OpenCode sessions from the past week.
say_en.note: Claude will run the script to list OpenCode sessions.

say_en.text: Read the full transcript for session ID abc123.
say_en.note: Claude will display the detailed session content.
